static_traits.name: Carter
static_traits.social_status: 与同为Writer的同伴及同事关系因创作受阻而紧张;有少数亲密朋友可倾诉,但他们not完全理解其写作过程中的挑战
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病;without既往心理咨询/治疗史;not yet曾经历类似的创作阻滞
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent thinking; tone tends negative and pessimistic; able to cooperate in discussion and willing to try small steps; presents cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, overgeneralization, and personalization

basic_info.main_problem: Long stuck when conceiving ideas for the next book, leading to significant stress and frustration.
basic_info.core_demands: Creative block markedly affects work and deadlines; seeks support and guidance to alleviate this problem.

special_situations.event: When sitting down to write or starting to brainstorm, the mind goes blank; this happens almost every day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能立即想到足够好的点子,就说明I am not good enough或会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to spark inspiration by changing the writing environment and daily routine
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我可能再也想not出任何主意/我永远写not出来

special_situations.event: Facing continuous pressure from others' expectations and deadlines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能按时产出高质量作品,就等于失败并让他人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断尝试各种方法试图提升产出与效率
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 压力太大,I will fail,达not到期待

special_situations.event: 更换环境与作息等常见方法后仍without明显效果
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果常见方法都without效,那就证明我从根本上have not能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps changing methods or increasing attempt frequency to verify whether effective
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not任何方法对我有效,我可能without法Recovery

special_situations.event: 与同行Writer和同事的关系因进度停滞而变得紧张
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not进展,就会影响合作,这说明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces collaboration and communication to avoid evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我拖累了do not人,Relationship tensionIt is all my fault

core_conflict.wish: 渴望作为Writer被认可,按时完成创作并保持稳定的创作能力
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与达not到他人期望,从而被negate
defense_goal: Reduces the inner sense of failure by emphasizing external pressure
以自我苛责与高标准维持警惕以避免被评价为without能

object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges with very high expectations (colleagues/industry)
not理解其创作困境的朋友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师邀请其从not同视角看问题并挑战'永远写not出来'的信念时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将'without望的感受'当成事实,认为任何尝试都not会奏效
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以外界压力与截止期为主要理由,语气谨慎而坚定地说明'这次not一样',对建议表达怀疑,如'压力太大,not用'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about specific moments of blockage (such as staring at a blank page for a long time)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将一次失败经验泛化为永久性结论,认为自己'永远not行'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use绝对化词语(如'永远/完全/一点也not'),拒绝承认任何中间可能.

manifestations: 创意枯竭,对作为Writer的能力产生整体怀疑
Setbacks in work and collaboration; difficulty advancing projects
Bound by outside expectations and deadlines, feeling unable to create autonomously
朋友not完全理解其写作困境

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁Self-doubt(如'I am not good enough''I will fail')
对改变持谨慎态度,担心效果not佳
Puts the possibility of failure first, reducing motivation to try

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats others' expectations and deadlines as rigid standards that must be met
形成'达not到就等于失败'的内在规则

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 认为朋友not理解其创作困境,从而体验被疏离与失望

positive_force: 具备文学创作的专业背景(文学创作Bachelor's degree)
Has overcome writing blocks in the past and eventually produced ideas (though this time it is more severe)
Has a few close friends to confide in (some social support)
negative_force: Cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing and all-or-nothing thinking are strong, with a tendency to overgeneralize and predict the worst outcome
Self-doubt严重,担心without法满足期望与截止日期
创作阻滞几乎每日发生,Work受损,Interpersonal tension
压力与Anxiety导致Sleep disturbed,日常节律混乱

target_behavior.behavior: 写作时出现创作阻滞并伴随强烈Self-doubt与Anxiety
antecedent: Sitting down to write or starting to brainstorm
尝试写作not yet见成效时
target_behavior.core_reason: 灾难化,非黑即白,A cognitive pattern of overgeneralization and personalization将暂时困难视为永久失败,triggerAnxiety与僵滞
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与失败的风险,短期降低Anxiety但维持阻滞
target_behavior.consequence: Work能力下降,难以按时完成写作任务;与同行Relationship tension;Sleep disturbed,日常生活被打乱
